$comment: Default source for each shared library, used when nothing higher in the precedence
chain names one. Precedence, highest first:
A source is a local path, a git URL with an optional '@<ref>' or '#<ref>', or a
GitHub/GitLab web URL of the form '<repo>/tree/<ref>'. The ref may be a branch, a
tag or a commit SHA, and may be omitted for the default branch.
The defaults below track 'main'. Pin a tag here once the libraries cut releases: a
default branch moves, so an unpinned default makes two runs a week apart generate
different pipelines from the same inputs.
'platforms' says which libraries a run on that platform actually reads.
